one_liner.zh: 用全局热键和设置页录制 Windows 全屏为 MP4
one_liner.en: Record a Windows desktop to MP4 with a hotkey or settings panel

local: Windows desktop; screen capture uses ffmpeg gdigrab.
ffmpeg must be available on PATH or configured with a full path.
Writes configuration and trigger/log files under the DSH recorder directory and recordings under the configured output directory.

config_items.name: DSH_HOME
config_items.description: Overrides the DSH home directory used for recorder configuration.
